name: Jaroslav Bžoch - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Agreement between the European Union and Bosnia and Herzegovina on operational activities carried out by the European Border and Coast Guard Agency in Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should sign a deal with Bosnia and Herzegovina. The deal lets the European Border and Coast Guard Agency send border management teams to work there. Those teams can use executive powers, such as border checks, on Bosnian territory. The aim is to manage migration, fight cross-border crime and people smuggling, and reduce irregular crossings into the European Union. The agreement must respect fundamental rights.

- The European Union and Bosnia and Herzegovina sign a border cooperation agreement.
- It affects border guards, migrants and people living near the Bosnian border.
- The agency must report to the European Parliament on its work there.
